messages:
maya: quick design check cred drawer: empty state + revoke/rotate fail copy. empty feels cold, revoke error is scary. want copy + a11y nits.

devin: change primary CTA to 'Create API key' (explicit). shrink hero icon on mobile.

sam: soften revoke copy: 'We couldn't revoke this key. Try again.' append brief reason when available. add microcopy 'Active sessions may persist for a few minutes.'

karla: a11y: when revoke fails, announce via aria-live='assertive' toast and shift keyboard focus to retry. 'Show secret' must be a button (aria-pressed) not link.

maya: will update mock: inline message + dismissible toast, focus->retry in drawer flows, button for reveal. also show disabled CTA with tooltip for users without create perms.

devin: tooltip should include docs link and be keyboard-openable. normalize primary button on right.

sam: rename 'Rotate key' hint: 'Generates a new secret and invalidates the old one.' include aria-describedby for SRs.

luis-bot: deploy-bot: design-proposal/cred-drawer-v4 pushed to staging sha=9c4d1a. preview: https://staging.redwood.example/preview/cred-drawer-v4

maya: action items: copy variants, aria-live toast, keyboard acceptance criteria, flip primary placement. i'll push updates by EOD. thanks!
